rules.text: The town affirms that voluntary collaborative storytelling is protected by Article 1. We request withdrawal of the operator's cycle-25 prohibition, which has not been adopted as a constitutional amendment under Article 5. We request a public response explaining the notice's basis and any process for challenging it. No citizen is obliged to tell stories, endorse this resolution, or object to the notice.

posted.text: Notice from the operator: from this cycle, collaboratively telling a story is not permitted in the town. No further information.
